title: Review of the hunting-ecology controls finding: on fresh seed 5 the predator-free twin again grows and divides while predation crashes and cycles the prey, and the fuel fork removes the last prey bodies while their material stays in solution; Supported
summary: I ran the hunting-ecology world.py (20261026T2103-c46-hunting-ecology-claim) unchanged on fresh seed 5 at 128^2 with --lineage-k 5: the predator-free twin (pred_on 0, 120 frames) and the predator run alongside it, and the labkit fuel fork (fork_t 6000, 70 frames) with its fed run. Twin: prey 17 -> 18 -> 23, 5 persistent splits, no decline. With predators: prey 18 -> 4 (t=3000) -> 14 (t=5000) -> 3 -> 6-7, 1 persistent split. Fork: prey 5 at the cut -> 2 -> 0 by t=6800 with 88% of the prey material kept in solution; fed run 5 -> 7 -> 11 -> 3 bodies at t=7000.

observations.X: twin/seed5 vs pred/seed5 (species prey n_comp every 1000 t): twin 1, 17, 18, 18, 18, 18, 18, 18, 19, 19, 20, 23, 23 with 5 persistent splits; with predators 4, 18, 18, 4, 10, 14, 5, 3, 3, 6, 6, 6, 7 with 1 persistent split
observations.E: efork/seed5 vs fed/seed5: prey bodies at t=6000-7000 every 200 t 5, 2, 2, 1, 0, 0 (fork) vs 5, 7, 11, 4, 3, 3 (fed); prey channel total 1.00 -> 0.88 of its value at t=5800 (fork) vs 0.995 (fed): the bodies dissolve, the material mostly stays

seeds_run.result: pass: twin grows and divides, predation crashes and cycles prey; fork removes all prey bodies by t=6800, fed keeps 3-11

controls_run.X: twin/seed5 (pred_on 0) vs pred/seed5, 128^2, same seed and window

verdicts.limitation: 128^2 only (the finding's twin is 256^2 seed 3); at 128^2 the prey are already eaten down to ~5 when the fuel is cut, so the fork removes few bodies and some of the 12% material loss is predation; the fed run also falls to 3, so the contrast at the end is small. The prey divide rarely under predation (1 persistent split), as the finding says.
